third_party_evaluations.summary: Practical digital forensics: disk, memory, network artefacts.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Practical disk, memory and network evidence analysis with a three-year profile supports professional forensic delivery; recorded NICCS recognition corroborates relevance without establishing expert investigative leadership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded hands-on disk, memory and network forensics with a three-year profile supports professional DFIR delivery. The NICCS hint adds context, while no detailed reporting or experience-verification evidence supports expert case leadership.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded fully hands-on assessment spans disk, memory and network artifacts at a three-year level. That practical forensic scope directly supports professional investigation work.
